name: double-entry-generator-639ea224-blind29-ots
instr:
# double-entry-generator-regen

I put a season of downloaded bank, card and shopping statements, along with the lists of rules I wrote myself, through this tool to get double-entry bookkeeping lines out, and very little comes back the way it used to. The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about my files or my rules changed. What follows is everything I could pin down from the outside.

Every run, whatever file I feed in, hands back one item more than the file holds, and the extra one is blank and sits ahead of the real ones: a four-row statement reports five transactions, and the line I expect first is now second.

Feeding in a plain comma-separated file together with a mapping of which column means what is worse than that. A file with a header line and a single filled-in row comes back with nothing in it at all and no complaint raised, and so does a two-row headerless file whose money-in and money-out sit in separate columns. The same silence swallows my own mistakes: I used to be able to cut a rule's test off right after the comparison sign and get back an error naming the offending rule, and now the run finishes quietly with an empty result and no error whatsoever. Even a row that carries every mapped column loses information on the way out — a column I aimed at the per-transaction notes never shows up in those notes, and the accounts my rules pick are not on the finished transaction either.
